content.body: The United Nations has formally adopted 'Türkiye' as the official name of the country previously known as Turkey, in a move effective immediately. The change aligns with the Turkish government's request to rebrand the nation internationally. The UN's decision, confirmed on June 1, 2022, means all official documents and communications will now refer to the country as Türkiye. This development follows a campaign by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan to promote the Turkish spelling of the country's name. The official UN name of Turkey is Türkiye. The change has been welcomed by Turkish officials and is expected to be implemented across international organizations and diplomatic channels. The UN's decision marks a significant step in the country's efforts to assert its cultural identity on the global stage.
